data_description.presence_entities: Do not activate the room. Hold an already active controller while presence is detected. After the final sensor clears, the normal vacancy delay begins.

data.sensor_resets_timer: Duration sensor resets timer when released

data_description.sensor_type: Event starts the timer. Duration keeps EC active while the trigger remains active.
data_description.sensor_resets_timer: For Duration only: starts the full activity time again after the last trigger is released.
data_description.backoff_enabled: Repeated triggers can gradually extend activity time.

data_description.state_entities: Optional extra entities used to observe the real state. Controlled entities are observed automatically.
data_description.blocking_enabled: Manual changes outside EC put the controller into Blocked instead of immediately overwriting them.
data_description.block_timeout_seconds: Zero disables the timeout. Active interlocks stay blocked until cleared.
data_description.protect_manual_off: After an external OFF, wait until the room clears so another trigger does not immediately turn it back on.
data_description.protect_manual_on: Preserve external ON, brightness, color and other significant adjustments during the current activity session.

data_description.override_entities: An active override temporarily replaces normal EC logic.
data_description.interlock_entities: An active interlock blocks this controller. One Helper may be shared by multiple controllers.

constraints.name: Allowed time window

data.constraint_enabled: Limit operation to a time window

constraints.description: Outside this allowed window EC is constrained and normal triggers do not start it.

night.name: Night profile
night.description: The night profile does not block EC. It can use a different activity time and service data during its window.

actions.name: State transition actions

data.lifecycle_actions: Custom HA actions by lifecycle hook

actions.description: Defines what EC does while entering or leaving states. By default it turns on on activation and off on return to idle.

data_description.lifecycle_actions: Map a lifecycle hook (such as on_enter_active) to a native HA action sequence. Scenes can be applied with scene.turn_on.

advanced.name: Advanced state mapping
advanced.description: Values in neither list are neutral and leave the current condition unchanged. Unknown, unavailable, and transitional states count only when listed.
